mapper.sql: id, parent_id, permission_code, permission_name, permission_type, api_path, sort_num, description, status, created_at, updated_at
mapper.select: select count(1) from sys_permission where parent_id = #{parentId}
mapper.insert: insert into sys_permission (parent_id, permission_code, permission_name, permission_type, api_path, sort_num, description, status, created_at, updated_at) values (#{parentId}, #{permissionCode}, #{permissionName}, #{permissionType}, #{apiPath}, #{sortNum}, #{description}, #{status}, now(), now())
mapper.select: select distinct p.id, p.parent_id, p.permission_code, p.permission_name, p.permission_type, p.api_path, p.sort_num, p.description, p.status, p.created_at, p.updated_at from sys_permission p inner join sys_role_permission rp on rp.permission_id = p.id inner join sys_user_role ur on ur.role_id = rp.role_id where ur.user_id = #{userId} order by p.sort_num asc, p.id asc
